releases.notes:
# Cheat Program v1.2

Cheat Program v1.2 brings the latest projection, floating-lyric, music, parkour and compatibility work into one versioned release. Every download identifies both its Minecraft version and mod loader. The project version embedded in every JAR is **1.2**.

## Highlights

- **Shared projections:** share a selected application screen through a revocable invitation. Choose up to 1080p60 or source resolution and capture cadence, with high-quality compression and bounded latest-frame queues.
- **Native shared floating lyrics:** synchronize displayed lyrics, translations, placement, colors and animation as text and 3D scene data. The receiving client renders the scene locally.
- **Private invitations:** generated and pasted invitations stay hidden until the eye icon is clicked. Copying still works while hidden; leaving the page, replacing or regenerating an invitation restores masking.
- **Direct sharing and an optional relay:** leave the address blank for direct LAN hosting, or run the included TLS relay for reachable internet deployments. Payloads use authenticated end-to-end encryption. Invitations can be revoked and regenerated.
- **AutoParkour:** sequential waypoints, a detached waypoint editor, advance route prediction, detours, water-aware planning and compound multi-wall jump planning. Route ribbons offer width, lifetime, rainbow and transgender-color controls.
- **Music and visual tools:** in-world music-library interaction, spatial album layouts, artwork preloading, particle paths, building analysis and preview visits, AI-assisted creation, and independent configuration codes.
- **Compatibility updates:** Fabric 26.3, separate Forge 1.20.1 and 1.20.4 artifacts, and continued input, rendering, HUD and interface fixes.

## Downloads

Install exactly one JAR matching both your Minecraft version and loader. Remove the previous Cheat Program JAR from that instance's mods folder before installing the replacement. Existing configuration uses the same mod ID and local configuration directory.

| Loader | Minecraft | Project | Minimum Java | File |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Fabric | 1.20.1 | v1.2 | 21 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc1.20.1.jar |
| Fabric | 1.20.4 | v1.2 | 21 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc1.20.4.jar |
| Fabric | 1.21.4 | v1.2 | 21 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc1.21.4.jar |
| Fabric | 1.21.10 | v1.2 | 21 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc1.21.10.jar |
| Fabric | 1.21.11 | v1.2 | 21 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc1.21.11.jar |
| Fabric | 26.1 | v1.2 | 25 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc26.1.jar |
| Fabric | 26.1.1 | v1.2 | 25 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc26.1.1.jar |
| Fabric | 26.1.2 | v1.2 | 25 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc26.1.2.jar |
| Fabric | 26.2 | v1.2 | 25 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc26.2.jar |
| Fabric | 26.3 | v1.2 | 25 | cheat-program-v1.2-fabric-mc26.3.jar |
| Forge | 1.20.1 | v1.2 | 21 | cheat-program-v1.2-forge-mc1.20.1.jar |
| Forge | 1.20.4 | v1.2 | 21 | cheat-program-v1.2-forge-mc1.20.4.jar |

Fabric 26.3 requires Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer and the OpenGL graphics backend. The Forge builds target Forge 47.4.0+ for Minecraft 1.20.1 and Forge 49.2.13+ for Minecraft 1.20.4.

## Sharing requirements and limits

Video sharing requires FFmpeg on both clients. Native floating lyrics do not require a video codec. Audio is not included in shared projections. Source mode uses high-quality compression; it is not a mathematically lossless or zero-latency guarantee. Actual throughput depends on both clients, capture, encoding and the network.

Direct sharing requires reachable peers. A LAN invitation does not automatically work across the internet; remote use needs a reachable direct host or a configured relay. The invitation contains private viewing credentials. Reveal it only when needed and hide it in screenshots or recordings. See the [shared-viewing guide](https://github.com/Mellivyne/cheat-program/blob/main/docs/shared-projections.md).

# Cheat Program v1.1 — updated downloads

This update keeps the project version at **v1.1** and replaces the downloads on the existing **v1.0** and **v1.1** release pages with all nine rebuilt Fabric JARs. The release page labels stay in place as history; each attached file is marked with its actual project version, **v1.1**.

## Changes in this update

- **Redistribution requires attribution:** retain the project copyright and applicable license notices, including the Required Notice with the project name and repository URL for this revision.
- Added a fixed, clickable **github.com/Mellivyne/cheat-program** link at the far right of the control-panel row containing the AI Players tab, including its embedded 3D form.
- Changed the licensing of new original changes to **PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0**, including a required project attribution notice. This is a **source-available, noncommercial** revision; this license does not grant commercial-use permission.
- Preserved the historical MIT grant and its redistribution conditions for material covered by that grant. Third-party components keep their own licenses. Read [LICENSING.md](https://github.com/Mellivyne/cheat-program/blob/main/LICENSING.md) for the exact boundary and required notice.
- Included the new license, earlier MIT notice, licensing scope and third-party notices in all JARs.

The production badge/address helpers passed isolated layout and interaction checks. All nine targets passed clean builds and artifact checks, including exact Minecraft/Java constraints, module/mixin contents and license files. No Minecraft instance was launched for this small revision; final in-game placement remains available for user feedback.

## Downloads

The nine files below are the current rebuilt artifacts, and their project-version filenames are **v1.1**. Install the JAR for your exact Minecraft version and replace the older Cheat Program JAR in that instance. Do not keep both installed. `SHA256SUMS.txt` is included.

| Minecraft | Project version | Java | JAR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1.20.1 | v1.1 | 21+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc1.20.1.jar` |
| 1.20.4 | v1.1 | 21+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc1.20.4.jar` |
| 1.21.4 | v1.1 | 21+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc1.21.4.jar` |
| 1.21.10 | v1.1 | 21+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc1.21.10.jar` |
| 1.21.11 | v1.1 | 21+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1 | v1.1 | 25+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc26.1.jar` |
| 26.1.1 | v1.1 | 25+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc26.1.1.jar` |
| 26.1.2 | v1.1 | 25+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc26.1.2.jar` |
| 26.2 | v1.1 | 25+ | `cheat-program-v1.1-fabric-mc26.2.jar` |

**The 1.20.1 and 1.20.4 builds also require Java 21 or newer.** `SHA256SUMS.txt` is attached alongside the nine JARs.


---

## Features and fixes introduced in v1.1

v1.1 expands building and particle creation, adds five music-library layouts, and updates all nine supported Fabric builds. Minecraft **1.20.1** and **1.20.4** are newly supported.

## Added

- **Building analysis:** native 3D block icons with names and quantities, maximum length/width/height, and horizontal-layer inspection with separate material totals for each layer.
- **First-person building visits:** enter an independent preview, move with WASD, fly with Space/Shift, and look around without moving your player in the live world.
- **AI building designer:** connect your own API key and model endpoint, describe a building or attach reference images, preview the generated blocks, and request further revisions. Generated buildings use the same materials, layer analysis and visit controls.
- **AI particle designer:** turn text and reference images into native particle compositions and motion paths, preview and revise the result, and export its independent CPS1 configuration code.
